A MACEDONIA Laboratory resource with five views for looking things up and studying. In **chemistry**: the **periodic table** with electron configuration (condensed, full and as orbital boxes) and an animated atom, the **functional groups** and the **20 amino acids** with their structures. In **physics**: the **Standard Model of particles** and the **quantities and units** of the International System. Cards flip to show the key facts on the back.
